playstore_details.description:
💰 Take Full Control of Your Finances — Anytime, Anywhere

Saver is the smart, privacy-first expense manager that helps you track every dollar, understand your spending habits, and receive personalized AI-powered savings tips — even without an internet connection.

Whether you're trying to save money for a goal, break a bad spending habit, or simply know where your paycheck goes, Saver gives you the clarity and guidance you need, all in one place. And the best part? Every single feature is completely free, with no limits, no subscriptions, and no hidden costs.

📊 COMPLETE EXPENSE TRACKING
• Log incomes and expenses in seconds
• Organize transactions with fully customizable categories (icons + colors)
• Attach receipt photos and scan them automatically with AI to fill in amounts and details
• Visualize your financial health through beautiful interactive charts and summaries
• Filter and review your transaction history by date, category, or amount

🤖 AI SAVINGS TIPS — POWERED BY GEMINI
Saver integrates Google's Gemini AI to deliver intelligent, personalized financial advice based on your actual spending patterns:

• Get actionable tips to reduce unnecessary expenses
• Receive smart budget recommendations tailored to your lifestyle
• Understand trends in your spending before they become a problem
• AI assistance is available at any time — online or offline

🌐 ONLINE: Powered by Gemini AI in the cloud for richer, context-aware insights.
📴 OFFLINE: Powered by Gemini Nano 4 on-device — the same great AI experience without needing Wi-Fi or mobile data.

📴 100% OFFLINE CAPABLE
Saver is designed to work fully offline. No internet? No problem:

• Register and log all your transactions locally on your device
• Get AI savings tips powered by Gemini Nano 4, running entirely on-device
• Your data is always accessible — on a plane, in a remote area, or when your connection drops
• Sync to the cloud automatically when you're back online (optional)

🔒 YOUR PRIVACY IS OUR PRIORITY
We believe your financial data belongs to you — and only you:

✅ Zero data collection: We do NOT collect, sell, or share your personal or financial data
✅ All features run locally on your device — no data ever leaves without your consent
✅ Offline-first architecture: Gemini Nano 4 runs on your device, not on a remote server
✅ You are always in control of your information

🆓 100% FREE — NO LIMITS, NO SUBSCRIPTIONS
Every feature in Saver is available to everyone, completely free of charge:

• No paywalls — access all tools from day one
• No subscription required — ever
• No transaction limits or category limits
• No ads interrupting your experience
• Full AI capabilities included at no cost

✨ MORE FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE

🌍 Multi-language support: English, Spanish, Italian
🌙 Light & Dark theme — automatically adapts to your system preference
📷 AI receipt scanner — just snap a photo and let Saver fill in the details
🔑 Secure login with Email/Password or Google Sign-In
🎨 Personalize your categories with custom icons and colors
📱 Clean, modern Material Design interface — fast and intuitive

👥 WHO IS SAVER FOR?

✔ People who want to save money but don't know where to start
✔ Anyone tired of wondering where their paycheck went
✔ Budget-conscious individuals looking for smart AI guidance
✔ Users who value privacy and want full offline access
✔ Students, freelancers, families — anyone who wants to be financially smarter

🚀 START SAVING SMARTER TODAY
Download Saver now and join thousands of users who are finally in control of their money. Track every expense, build better habits, and let AI guide you toward a healthier financial future — all for free and without sacrificing your privacy.

Your money. Your rules. Your Saver. 💚
